objective: Determine the current end-to-end Arcanum skill model and whether Formulae, Transmutations, and Arcana can be replaced by one canonical skill model without losing required behavioral distinctions or breaking consumers.
evidence_boundary: Repository claims require exact repository-relative artifact and line citations.
Installed local skill-authoring contracts may be inspected only to distinguish native Codex requirements from Arcanum conventions.
Current behavior, documented intent, generated surfaces, and demonstrated runtime evidence must remain distinct.
No source capability, registry, installer, adapter, schema, or framework contract may be modified during research.
anti_bias_global: Repository-authority reconstruction is tensioned against consumer-impact falsification, then the synthesis is independently attacked for definitional soundness and migration operability.

agents.angle: Repository-first reconstruction of every current skill creation and promotion path, including overlapping owners and generated adapters.
agents.prompt: Work read-only. Read the validated baseline. Reconstruct the current end-to-end creation lifecycle from candidate capture through authoring, validation, trial, promotion, registry publication, installation, adapter generation, invocation, observation, and maintenance. Inspect the repo-specific sigil-development path and the installed native skill-creator contract where relevant. Distinguish canonical owners, optional helpers, generated surfaces, and observed gaps. Return a cited process model and contradictions; do not propose implementation.
agents.expected_output: Cited lifecycle and ownership map with canonical, overlapping, generated, and missing gates clearly separated.

agents.angle: Artifact-first reconstruction of the actual skill schema across Markdown contracts, frontmatter, sidecars, agent metadata, dependencies, validators, and runtime adapters.
agents.prompt: Work read-only. Read the validated baseline. Determine whether one authoritative skill schema exists. Inventory required, optional, descriptive, validated, generated, and runtime-consumed fields across representative packages and repository tooling. Distinguish native Codex skill requirements from Arcanum governance conventions. Return a field-by-field schema map with source of authority and enforcement evidence; do not design a replacement.
source_scope: representative SKILL.md packages across all current directories
agents.expected_output: Layered schema matrix showing authority, cardinality, validation, consumers, defaults, and unresolved conflicts.

agents.angle: Consumer-first falsification of the claim that the three directories are merely names and can be collapsed without semantic or compatibility loss.
agents.prompt: Work read-only. Read the validated baseline. Search every operational consumer of arcana, formulae, transmutations, tier, sigil, and skill: registries, installers, bootstrap scripts, generated adapters, dependency closure, dispatch schemas, observability, documentation links, tests, and external-facing downloads. Try to disprove safe consolidation by locating behavior keyed to directory or category. Classify each dependency as semantic, structural, cosmetic, generated, historical, or unknown. Return migration constraints and falsifiers, not a solution.
source_scope: entire repository excluding unrelated research content
agents.expected_output: Cited consumer-impact inventory with hard blockers, mechanical migrations, cosmetic references, and unresolved compatibility questions.

agents.angle: Evidence-preserving synthesis of the current model and consolidation candidates.
agents.prompt: After all explorer returns are joined, preserve them verbatim in research.md and write findings.md. Answer the user's three current-state questions first, then evaluate the declared candidates using owner, witnessed, sound, verdict, and use-mode. Keep documented intent, runtime requirements, governance conventions, and migration inference distinct. Preserve dissent and unknowns. Do not implement or turn the report into a final schema proposal.
source_scope: joined explorer returns and their cited artifacts only

agents.angle: Definitional-soundness attack on claims that sigil, skill, tier, category, schema, and runtime package are equivalent or distinct.
agents.prompt: Attack only definitional soundness. Verify that every important term is grounded in an authoritative repository or native runtime artifact, that descriptive conventions are not promoted into schemas, and that directory identity is not confused with runtime type. Return PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK with exact repairs. Do not edit artifacts.
agents.expected_output: Definitional gate verdict with exact ambiguous, conflated, or unsupported terms.

agents.angle: Operability and migration attack on the claim that consolidation preserves discovery, installation, dependency closure, and invocation.
agents.prompt: Attack only operability. Verify every claimed consolidation consequence against actual consumers and distinguish hard compatibility constraints from generated or cosmetic changes. Reject any safe-migration claim lacking a witnessed dependency inventory. Return PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK with exact repairs. Do not edit artifacts.
source_scope: cited tools, registries, adapters, manifests, tests, and consumers
agents.expected_output: Operability gate verdict identifying missing consumers, unsupported migration claims, or false blockers.

agents.angle: Final coverage, citation, dissent, boundary, and verdict audit.
agents.prompt: Read research.md, findings.md, both skeptic verdicts, and any one admitted writer revision. Check complete answers to current creation process, actual schema, categorization, canonical-unit question, consumer impact, candidate verdicts, citations, dissent, and absence of implementation. Return ACCEPT or REJECT with exact residue. Do not edit artifacts.
source_scope: final research artifacts and gate verdicts
agents.expected_output: Independent final audit verdict for the parent approver.

groups.purpose: Reconstruct creation, schema, and category consumers from independent evidence orientations.

predicted_disagreements.sentence: On the declared composite methodology + source-corpus axis, creation-process-cartographer runs repository-first lifecycle and ownership reconstruction, while schema-surface-cartographer runs artifact-first field and validator-witness classification; the first agent's documented-workflow bias is exposed by the second, and the second agent's schema-only bias is exposed by the first.

On the declared composite methodology + source-corpus axis, creation-process-cartographer runs canonical-owner reconstruction, while taxonomy-consumer-falsifier traces downstream consumers and generated paths; the first agent's intent-and-documentation bias is exposed by operational dependencies, and the second agent's consumer-only bias is exposed by authoritative lifecycle evidence.

On the declared composite methodology + source-corpus axis, schema-surface-cartographer classifies formal fields and enforcement witnesses, while taxonomy-consumer-falsifier searches for implicit path and naming dependencies; the first agent's formal-schema bias is exposed by undocumented consumers, and the second agent's implicit-contract bias is exposed by explicit schema authority.

groups.purpose: Join current-state evidence and consolidation candidates without erasing contradictions.
Apply distinct definitional and operability gates.

predicted_disagreements.sentence: On the attack-vector axis, definition-skeptic runs a definitional-soundness attack while operability-skeptic runs an operability-and-migration attack; the first agent's conceptual-equivalence bias is exposed by operational consumers, and the second agent's feasibility-only bias is exposed by definitional distinctions.

groups.purpose: Independently audit the final research package.

candidates: one canonical skill package is the actual reusable unit
the current creation lifecycle has one authoritative path
one authoritative skill schema exists today
the current three categories are operational runtime types
the three directories can be consolidated without losing required distinctions

stage_handoff_rules: Synthesis waits for all three explorer returns or typed partial failures.
Skeptics wait for both research.md and findings.md.
At most one writer revision may answer typed skeptic defects.
Audit waits for both skeptic verdicts and any admitted revision.

forbidden_evidence: credentials, tokens, personal data, or secrets
machine-specific absolute paths in published findings

validation: research-initial-definitions validator remains pass at the admitted SHA-256
every repository claim cites an inspected repository-relative artifact and locator
research.md preserves all explorer returns verbatim
findings.md answers creation process, actual schema, categorization, canonical unit, and consolidation implications
both skeptic gates and final audit pass before parent approval
stop_conditions: Stop before launch if confirmation readiness or either tension checker does not pass.
Stop source expansion when every named creation, schema, publication, installation, and runtime consumer question has a witnessed answer or explicit gap.
Stop downstream stages on missing required returns unless a typed partial failure preserves a bounded synthesis.
Stop after one writer revision loop and propagate remaining disagreement.
Do not implement, rename, move, or edit source skills during research.
